$comment: Per-engine browser-matrix ratchets (TASK-N1-O2). `known-failures.json` is the CROSS-ENGINE ledger: an entry there is expected to fail on every engine, and Playwright fails the run when it unexpectedly passes anywhere. This file records only what one engine measures DIFFERENTLY. `notReproducing` withdraws a cross-engine expectation for one engine and MUST carry the measured numbers that prove the divergence; `engineOnly` adds an expectation only one engine measures. Both are ratchets: entries are removed when the divergence is resolved and never added without a measured number, an engine version and a reason. A blanket per-engine skip is not a ratchet -- it is the lane narrowing without saying so.
admissibility: locally qualified, worktree-dirty -- NOT admissible as release evidence until an owner commits this tree and re-runs. The exact working-tree contents these numbers were measured against are inventoried by SHA-256 in docs/program-2026-09/reports/N1-O2-firefox-webkit-handoff.md section 2.
method: Every matrix-{engine}-{condition} project was executed against all 88 runnable Tier B-D targets (1 target is `unrun`: DzThemeProvider has no story). Divergences below were then re-measured element-by-element on each engine in isolation; the numbers recorded are those measurements, not the suite's summary.

notReproducingClosed.closureReason: The cross-engine ledger entry this record withdrew no longer exists: known-failures.json is empty. DzOrderList`s 2px/1px reflow divergence disappeared with the component: the overflow was the harness measuring min-content width under Storybook`s `layout: centered`, and is 0px on all three engines once the canvas is a real 320px block box.
notReproducingClosed.measuredWhenOpen: chromium/firefox/webkit document overflow at 320px: 0px each after the fix.

notReproducingClosed.closureReason: The cross-engine ledger entry this record withdrew no longer exists: known-failures.json is empty. The DzLightbox divergence was NOT a timing artefact, which is the correction this task owes N1-O2 finding E4 and owner decision D3. The three "transient" controls were DzLightbox`s own close and nav buttons rendering with NO class attribute, because the template bound `styles.closeButton` (the tv() slot function) instead of `styles.closeButton()`. Vue`s normalizeClass has no case for a function, so it emitted the empty string and the buttons were sized by the bare SVG inside them: 16x16 and 20x20 against the 32x32 and 40x40 the variants declare. WebKit "passed" only because it had already unmounted the teleported overlay by the time the assertion ran, so it measured nothing. All ten of the component`s slot bindings are fixed.
notReproducingClosed.measuredWhenOpen: close button 32x32, nav buttons 40x40 after the fix; chromium matrix-chromium-touch cell passes.

reMeasuredBy: TASK-N1-O3 re-ran all three engines end-to-end after fixing the 46 cross-engine entries. known-failures.json is now empty, so every summary below records a sweep in which no cell was expected to fail and none did.
